Spectral Identifier

Identify minerals from their spectra and fit their crystal cell with Ramanujan theta functions, on real measured data from the RRUFF database. Every number below is computed live.

# Run by Wilmer Espinoza on Oct 20, 2026, with his own Valency token (token not stored):
#   python -m src.ai.literature Zircon Vesuvianite Siderite --topic xrd
# Phases chosen from the tetragonal/hexagonal XRD validation: zircon (fit OK),
# vesuvianite (fit fails, very large cell), siderite (2 of 3 patterns explain few peaks).
# Known limit: the name check is a word match, not reading comprehension; e.g. Zircon #3
# is a compound "with the defect zircon structure", not the mineral itself.
